title: 独享的暗号
raw_requirement: Lin Lan 在 River Station 亲眼读到 Midnight Code：the box opens at midnight。Gu Che 不在现场、没有听说这条信息。Sealed Copper Box 完好。Missing Courier 尚未找到。两人合作调查，但不要扩写世界观。
recorded_draft:
Lin Lan waited at River Station beside the Sealed Copper Box. Its seal was intact. The Missing Courier had not returned, and no one had closed that investigation.

Inside a folded note, Lin Lan read the Midnight Code: the box opens at midnight. She read the words herself and kept the note. Gu Che was at Clock Tower, absent from the station; he neither saw nor heard the code.

Lin Lan and Gu Che had agreed to cooperate in finding the Missing Courier. The search remained pending. Lin Lan left a short message asking him to meet later, without including the code.
